entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: N-Ngh...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Do you want to finish him off? It's your call.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: No, please wait! I beg you... Just forgive meeee!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Shut up. I bet everyone told you the same.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But you... you took everything from them!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: *shriek*

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: I accept defeat... You want this? Take it.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: Go ahead and finish me off...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: You do that... and my real self will go down too...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: You have that right since you've won...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ann!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: If his mind shuts down, he can't admit his crimes.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You're kind, Lady Ann...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: I've lost.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: You're through when you lose...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: What am I— What am I supposed to do now?
Figure it out yourself.
Atone for your sins.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: All right... I will leave now and return to my real self...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: I'll make certain that I—

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, just so you know, we don't have time to waste.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This place is about to collapse!
